title: Yes, it's a grater, but not something I normally would use
text:
Yes, it's a grater, but not something I normally would use. I want to start by declaring that I am an avid chef having attended several weeks worth of cooking courses in the Tuscany region of Italy over the past few years. Having said that, I have been used to having a hand-held grater to do much of my grating of lemons, cheese, vegetables etc. It was something I picked up in Italy at a flea market for a few dollars similar to this style: [[ASIN:B004VLYQGS OXO Good Grips Fine Zester/Grater]].

This was my first time in using a box style grater. First, I found it bulky and difficult to manipulate (especially with trying to grate cheese). I also found clean up to be a little more difficult (not as easy to maneuver to the reverse side espcially when trying to use this with lemon rinds). I found myself scratching the back of my hand inside while trying to reach into all the nooks and crannys). I gave this 3 stars only because the product is well made, attractive and might be a style that someone may be looking for. It's just not something I will be using again. Give me the hand-held style any day.

product_metadata.title: Progressive International S4 Dual Edge Box Grater with Etched Stainless Steel Grating Surface
features: Tower grater with 2 etched stainless steel grating sides for coarse and medium grating
Patent-pending, extra-sharp etched stainless steel grating surface for higher output
V-style blades for faster, smoother, straighter grating
Large curved handle on top; non-skid base for stability; snap-on cover
description: Part of Progressive International's S4 line of graters, the Dual Edge Box Grater is perfect for all your basic grating needs. Sharp, straight, simple, and smart, each S4 grater features an etched stainless steel grating surface with Progressive's patent-pending design. The extra-sharp grating surface grates and zests faster, smoother and straighter--resulting in a higher output and less time spent grating.

Easy to use and comfortable to hold with a generously sized curved handle, the Dual Edge Box Grater includes coarse and medium grating surfaces. The coarse grater is great for basic grating such as cheese for quesadillas, while the medium surface ably grates carrots for salad (both are made of stainless steel). The V-style grater blades cause food to move straight down the grater for more efficient grating. Other features include clear side windows for a quick view of grated food, non-skid base, and snap-on cover for safe and convenient storage. Dishwasher safe.
Sharp etched grater surface makes for quick and easy grating. Snap-on cover for safe and easy storage.

After 38 years in business, Progressive International is still dedicated to creating functional gadgets, tools, food-prep items and household products to make your cooking and meal preparation more efficient and fun. Located in Kent, Washington, Progressive's products are sold in the United States, Canada, Europe, South America, and other international markets.

More than a workspace, the contemporary kitchen is the heart of the home where we connect with family and friends, and Progressive's philosophy of product design aims to create the perfect balance of form, function and value for your kitchen. The design process pulls from many different research methods such as ethnographic research, consumer testing, surveys, and in-home observations, identifying real life problems in the kitchen that translate to fresh, new ideas for smarter products.
